{{Quote|Are you crazy? Pointing that thing at a Jedi? Put it down '''now'''!|The spaceport police droid to Loubo after he picked up a frying pan|<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a '''[[Spaceport police droid/Legends|Spaceport police droid]]''' responded to an emergency call from a spaceport restaurant, [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar's]] [[Stobar Spaceport|spaceport]], after a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], nearly choked a [[Sassi/Legends|waitress]] to death. By the time the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] arrived, Savage had already fled the scene.

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] later arrived at the restaurant and the owner, [[Loubo/Legends|Loubo]], warned them to stay away from the fainted waitress. Seconds later, this droid arrived and scolded the owner for pointing a frying pan at the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid first appeared in the twenty-first episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]." He was voiced by [[Tom Kane]], the actor who also portrays [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the series.
